current_ability_details.description: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled. Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path. The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
current_ability_details.name: Illuminate

current_ability_details.description: A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is 175 range over 0.6 seconds.
current_ability_details.name: Blinding Light

current_ability_details.description: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is 30% more effective when used on himself.
current_ability_details.name: Chakra Magic

current_ability_details.description: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.
current_ability_details.name: Solar Bind

current_ability_details.description: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
current_ability_details.name: Will-O-Wisp

current_ability_details.description: Ezalor temporarily turns his body luminescent, gaining cast range, increasing the speed bonus from Bright Speed, and allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies.
current_ability_details.name: Spirit Form

current_ability_details.description: Release the channel early.
current_ability_details.name: Release Illuminate

current_ability_details.description:
Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every 2.5 Intelligence.

Whenever Keeper of the Light moves 300 distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see 400 range for 3 seconds.
current_ability_details.name: Bright Speed

current_ability_details.description: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for 3 seconds.
current_ability_details.name: Sticky Bomb

current_ability_details.description:
Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally, giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.

At the end of the effect or if detonated early with the sub-ability, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage.
current_ability_details.name: Reactive Tazer

current_ability_details.description: Techies hurtle themselves into the enemy's midst, detonating charges upon impact which deal massive area of effect damage and stun enemies. Upon landing, the assault deals Techies non-lethal damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
current_ability_details.name: Blast Off!

current_ability_details.description:
Techies gain a percentage of their mana pool as bonus mana regeneration.

When Techies die, they leave behind a barrel that explodes after 1.5s, damaging enemies in an area around it. Damage is based on Techies' max mana.
current_ability_details.name: M.A.D.

current_ability_details.description:
Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal 15% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts 240 seconds.

When an enemy Hero walks within 200 units of a minefield sign, the 1000 units area around the sign will become a minefield for 10 seconds, dealing damage to enemy Heroes any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.
current_ability_details.name: Minefield Sign

current_ability_details.description: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active 500 AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for 1 seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within 150 radius and decreases up to 60% on the edge. Deals 30% damage to buildings.
current_ability_details.name: Proximity Mines

current_ability_details.description: Detonate Reactive Tazer immediately.
current_ability_details.name: Detonate Tazer

current_ability_details.description: Detonate your planted M.A.D.
current_ability_details.name: Detonate M.A.D.

current_ability_details.description:
Launch into a maddened rage, becoming Debuff Immune, increasing magic resistance and gaining movement speed.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
current_ability_details.name: Rage

current_ability_details.description: Lifestealer rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.
current_ability_details.name: Open Wounds

current_ability_details.description: Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains permanent max HP whenever he kills a unit.
current_ability_details.name: Feast

current_ability_details.description: Passively grants Lifestealer Attack Speed.
current_ability_details.name: Ghoul Frenzy

current_ability_details.description:
Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
current_ability_details.name: Infest

current_ability_details.description: Lifestealer eats the host body from the inside out, exploding from within.
current_ability_details.name: Consume

current_ability_details.description: Summons 2 wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.
current_ability_details.name: Summon Wolves

current_ability_details.description: Strikes fear into enemies, reducing armor and attack damage of all enemies within 2000 range of Lycan and his wolves. At night, Howl's armor and attack damage reductions are global.
current_ability_details.name: Howl

current_ability_details.description: Increases the HP regeneration and damage of Lycan and all units under his control.
current_ability_details.name: Feral Impulse

current_ability_details.description: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain 40% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within 1200 range of each other.
current_ability_details.name: Wolf Bite

current_ability_details.description: Lycan and units he controls deal extra damage to neutral creeps.
current_ability_details.name: Apex Predator

current_ability_details.description: Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him critical strikes and added vision at night. During Shapeshift, Lycan moves at increased speed and cannot be slowed. Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control.
current_ability_details.name: Shapeshift

current_ability_details.description: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
current_ability_details.name: Poison Touch

current_ability_details.description: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
current_ability_details.name: Shallow Grave

current_ability_details.description: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby. Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
current_ability_details.name: Shadow Wave

current_ability_details.description: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.
current_ability_details.name: Weave

current_ability_details.description: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
current_ability_details.name: Nothl Projection

current_ability_details.description: Ends Dazzle's sojourn in the Nothl Realm and returns his spirit to his body.
current_ability_details.name: End Projection

current_ability_details.description:
After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself. Slark only takes 30% of the damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
current_ability_details.name: Dark Pact

current_ability_details.description: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
current_ability_details.name: Pounce

current_ability_details.description:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.
current_ability_details.name: Saltwater Shiv

current_ability_details.description: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.
current_ability_details.name: Depth Shroud

current_ability_details.description: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining 1 of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus 3 Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals 1 Agility.
current_ability_details.name: Essence Shift

current_ability_details.description:
When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration. If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for 2 seconds.

When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.
current_ability_details.name: Shadow Dance

current_ability_details.description: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
current_ability_details.name: Crypt Swarm

current_ability_details.description: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.
current_ability_details.name: Silence

current_ability_details.description: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.
current_ability_details.name: Spirit Siphon

current_ability_details.description: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts 40 seconds.
current_ability_details.name: Exorcism

current_ability_details.description: Dark Seer creates a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage.
current_ability_details.name: Vacuum

current_ability_details.description: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it.
current_ability_details.name: Ion Shell

current_ability_details.description: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.
current_ability_details.name: Surge

current_ability_details.description: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past 3 seconds. Max power is reached after 1100 distance moved.
current_ability_details.name: Normal Punch

current_ability_details.description:
Dark Seer gains 1 Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.
current_ability_details.name: Quick Wit

current_ability_details.description: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.
current_ability_details.name: Wall of Replica

current_ability_details.description: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed. The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a 1200 radius of each other.
current_ability_details.name: Shuriken Toss

current_ability_details.description: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.
current_ability_details.name: Jinada

current_ability_details.description: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell. If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
current_ability_details.name: Shadow Walk

current_ability_details.description: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is 0.5s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.
current_ability_details.name: Friendly Shadow

current_ability_details.description: Bounty Hunter receives 15% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.
current_ability_details.name: Big Game Hunter

current_ability_details.description: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.
current_ability_details.name: Track

current_ability_details.description: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.
current_ability_details.name: Dragon Slave

current_ability_details.description: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.
current_ability_details.name: Light Strike Array

current_ability_details.description: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts 18 seconds.
current_ability_details.name: Fiery Soul

current_ability_details.description: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.
current_ability_details.name: Flame Cloak

current_ability_details.description: Lina's abilities deal an additional 64% damage as burn damage over 4s.
current_ability_details.name: Slow Burn

current_ability_details.description: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.
current_ability_details.name: Laguna Blade
